mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_server_snapshot (server_id, account_id, sampled_at, status, error_code, capabilities_json, facts_json, created_at) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{accountId}, #{sampledAt}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, CAST(#{capabilitiesJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{factsJson} AS JSON), #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id, server_id, account_id, sampled_at, status, error_code, capabilities_json, facts_json, created_at FROM train_server_snapshot WHERE server_id = #{serverId} AND account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, snapshot_id DESC LIMIT 1
